# Commands

Every command starts with `/atcs` (alias `/traincontrol`). `/atcs help` and `/atcs <group> help` list what you may use. Arguments in angle brackets are required, in square brackets optional; `...` takes the rest of the line.

| Permission | Who has it by default |
|---|---|
| `atcs.use` | everyone |
| `atcs.manage` | operators |

## /atcs

AdvancedTrainControlSystem

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs status` | `atcs.manage` | Show plugin, network and integration status |
| `/atcs reload` | `atcs.manage` | Reload config.yml, messages.yml and network.yml |
| `/atcs editor` | `atcs.manage` | A one-time link to the web editor (stations, lines, boards, fares, the diagram, config) |
| `/atcs lint` | `atcs.manage` | Check the network for what will not work or not show, with what to do about it |
| `/atcs undo` | `atcs.manage` | Restore network.yml as it was before the last command edit |
| `/atcs history` | `atcs.manage` | List the earlier versions of network.yml that /atcs undo can restore |
| `/atcs debug [on\|off]` | `atcs.manage` | Log every platform signal and journey event to the console |
| `/atcs station ...` | `atcs.use` | Stations and platforms (see below) |
| `/atcs line ...` | `atcs.use` | Lines and their colours (see below) |
| `/atcs service ...` | `atcs.use` | Services: the stopping patterns trains run (see below) |
| `/atcs train ...` | `atcs.use` | Trains and their services (see below) |
| `/atcs trains` | `atcs.manage` | List loaded trains and what they run |
| `/atcs departures <station> [platform]` | `atcs.use` | Show the next departures from a station |
| `/atcs transfer ...` | `atcs.use` | Walking transfers between nearby stations (see below) |
| `/atcs board ...` | `atcs.manage` | Departure boards on signs (see below) |
| `/atcs display ...` | `atcs.manage` | Pictures in item frames and hologram boards, placed with the wand (see below) |
| `/atcs switch ...` | `atcs.manage` | Switch signs and directions set by hand (see below) |
| `/atcs wand [pos1\|pos2\|clear\|info]` | `atcs.manage` | Get the selection wand: left click and right click two corners, then place displays or footprints |
| `/atcs map` | `atcs.use` | Get a hand-held map of the railway that shows where you are |
| `/atcs import ...` | `atcs.manage` | Set up the network from existing signs and running trains (see below) |
| `/atcs fare ...` | `atcs.use` | Fares between stations: explicit pairs, zones, and a formula over the route (see below) |
| `/atcs timing ...` | `atcs.manage` | How good the arrival estimates are, measured against real arrivals (see below) |

## /atcs station

Stations and platforms.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs station list [page]` | `atcs.use` | List stations |
| `/atcs station info <station>` | `atcs.use` | Show a station's platforms, triggers and lines |
| `/atcs station here` | `atcs.use` | Which station and platform you are at, its trains and the sign variables to use |
| `/atcs station code <station> <code\|auto>` | `atcs.manage` | Set the short code used in sign variables, for example gb |
| `/atcs station create <id> <name...>` | `atcs.manage` | Create a station |
| `/atcs station rename <station> <name...>` | `atcs.manage` | Change a station's passenger name |
| `/atcs station remove <station> [confirm]` | `atcs.manage` | Remove a station |
| `/atcs station bind <station> [platform]` | `atcs.manage` | Use the TrainCarts sign you look at as a platform trigger |
| `/atcs station unbind` | `atcs.manage` | Stop using the sign you look at as a trigger |
| `/atcs station bindall <station> [platform]` | `atcs.manage` | Bind every TrainCarts station sign in the wand selection as a platform trigger |
| `/atcs station footprint <station> [clear]` | `atcs.manage` | Make the wand selection the station's footprint: players inside it are at the station |
| `/atcs station convert [confirm]` | `atcs.manage` | Turn the TrainCarts station signs of the platforms in network.yml into atcs station signs |
| `/atcs station platform <station> <platform> [name...]` | `atcs.manage` | Create or rename a platform |
| `/atcs station locate <station>` | `atcs.manage` | Show the station on maps where you stand |
| `/atcs station map <station> pin <column> <row>\|unpin\|hide\|show\|label <left\|right\|above\|below\|auto>` | `atcs.manage` | Adjust the station on the website's diagram: pin it to a cell, hide it, or put its name on one side |

## /atcs line

Lines and their colours.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs line list` | `atcs.use` | List lines |
| `/atcs line info <line>` | `atcs.use` | Show a line and its services |
| `/atcs line create <id> <color> <name...>` | `atcs.manage` | Create a line, e.g. /atcs line create a #E53935 Line A |
| `/atcs line addstop <line> <stop> between <station> <station>` | `atcs.manage` | Add a stop to every service of the line that runs straight between the two stations |
| `/atcs line rename <line> <name...>` | `atcs.manage` | Change a line's name |
| `/atcs line mapcolor <line> <color\|auto>` | `atcs.manage` | Draw the line in another colour on the website's diagram, when its badge colour is too light there |
| `/atcs line color <line> <color>` | `atcs.manage` | Change a line's colour (#RRGGBB or a colour name) |
| `/atcs line badge <line> <text>` | `atcs.manage` | Set the short badge shown on boss bars and boards |
| `/atcs line suspend <line> [notice...]` | `atcs.manage` | Show a suspension notice to passengers and on boards |
| `/atcs line resume <line>` | `atcs.manage` | Clear a suspension notice |
| `/atcs line remove <line> [confirm]` | `atcs.manage` | Remove a line and all its services |

## /atcs service

Services: the stopping patterns trains run.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs service info <line/service>` | `atcs.use` | Show a service's stops and what has been learned |
| `/atcs service create <line/service> [name...]` | `atcs.manage` | Create a service, e.g. /atcs service create a/local-north Local |
| `/atcs service stops <line/service> <stop...>` | `atcs.manage` | Set the stops: station, station:platform, ~station to run through |
| `/atcs service addstop <line/service> <stop> [first\|last\|before <station>\|after <station>]` | `atcs.manage` | Add one stop; the rest of the list and what was learned stay |
| `/atcs service removestop <line/service> <station>` | `atcs.manage` | Drop a stop; the rest of the list and what was learned stay |
| `/atcs service record <line/service>\|stop\|cancel` | `atcs.manage` | Record stops by riding a train along the route |
| `/atcs service spawn <line/service>` | `atcs.manage` | New trains from the TrainCarts spawn sign you look at run this service |
| `/atcs service unspawn` | `atcs.manage` | Stop assigning new trains from the spawn sign you look at |
| `/atcs service hours <line/service> <from-to\|always>` | `atcs.manage` | When the service's fleet runs, for example 06:00-23:00; outside, trains are stabled at the end of their trip |
| `/atcs service offpeak <line/service> <trains> <from-to>\|off` | `atcs.manage` | Fewer fleet trains during part of the day, for example 2 22:00-06:00 |
| `/atcs service fleet <line/service> <trains> <every> <train>\|off` | `atcs.manage` | Let ATCS keep trains running on a service without spawn signs; stand on the rail facing their way |
| `/atcs service reverse <line/service> <new-service> [name...]` | `atcs.manage` | Create the opposite direction of a service |
| `/atcs service rename <line/service> <name...>` | `atcs.manage` | Change the passenger-facing service name |
| `/atcs service circular <line/service> <true\|false>` | `atcs.manage` | Whether the last stop is followed by the first |
| `/atcs service continues <line/service> <line/service\|none>` | `atcs.manage` | What trains become after the last stop |
| `/atcs service match <line/service> [destination\|tag\|train-name <value>\|clear]` | `atcs.manage` | Assign trains automatically by TrainCarts destination, tag or name |
| `/atcs service remove <line/service>` | `atcs.manage` | Remove a service |
| `/atcs service resetpaths <line/service>` | `atcs.manage` | Forget the recorded track paths drawn on maps |

## /atcs train

Trains and their services.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs train info [train]` | `atcs.use` | Show the train you ride or look at |
| `/atcs train assign <line/service> [train]` | `atcs.manage` | Run a train as a service |
| `/atcs train unassign [train]` | `atcs.manage` | Take a train out of service and off automatic assignment |
| `/atcs train auto [train]` | `atcs.manage` | Let spawn signs, match rules and its route assign a train again |
| `/atcs train hold <train> [reason...]` | `atcs.manage` | Keep a train at its current or next station sign until released |
| `/atcs train skip <train> <station>` | `atcs.manage` | Make a train run through a station it would call at, once; riders are told |
| `/atcs train release <train>` | `atcs.manage` | Let a held train go |

## /atcs transfer

Walking transfers between nearby stations.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs transfer add <station> <station> [walk] [outside\|inside]` | `atcs.manage` | Let passengers change between two stations on foot; walk is m:ss or seconds, estimated when left out |
| `/atcs transfer remove <station> <station>` | `atcs.manage` | Remove a walking transfer |
| `/atcs transfer list` | `atcs.use` | List walking transfers |

## /atcs board

Departure boards on signs.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs board create <id> <station> [platform...]` | `atcs.manage` | Make the sign you look at a departure board |
| `/atcs board add <id>` | `atcs.manage` | Add the sign you look at as the board's next line of departures |
| `/atcs board unbind` | `atcs.manage` | Remove the sign you look at from its board |
| `/atcs board remove <id>` | `atcs.manage` | Remove a board (its signs keep their last text) |
| `/atcs board list` | `atcs.manage` | List boards |

## /atcs display

Pictures in item frames and hologram boards, placed with the wand.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs display roadmap <line[/service]> <station> [platform]` | `atcs.manage` | Fill the selected item frames with the line's strip diagram and 'you are here' |
| `/atcs display logo <station>` | `atcs.manage` | Fill the selected item frames with the station's logo |
| `/atcs display board <station> [platform...]` | `atcs.manage` | Fill the selected item frames with a departure board picture that keeps updating |
| `/atcs display map [station]` | `atcs.manage` | Fill the selected item frames with the network map, marking the station |
| `/atcs display status` | `atcs.manage` | Fill the selected item frames with a service status panel of every line |
| `/atcs display hologram <station> [platform...]` | `atcs.manage` | Put a floating departure board at the selection's centre, or where you look |
| `/atcs display list` | `atcs.manage` | List displays |
| `/atcs display remove <display>` | `atcs.manage` | Take a display down: empty its frames or remove its hologram |
| `/atcs display redraw` | `atcs.manage` | Draw every display again, for example after changing a logo file |

## /atcs switch

Switch signs and directions set by hand.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs switch list` | `atcs.manage` | List the switch signs in loaded chunks and any direction set by hand |
| `/atcs switch set <world,x,y,z> <direction> [minutes]` | `atcs.manage` | Send every train at the sign that way for a while (10 minutes unless given), whatever its rules say |
| `/atcs switch clear <world,x,y,z>` | `atcs.manage` | Let the sign's rules decide again |

## /atcs import

Set up the network from existing signs and running trains.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs import scan` | `atcs.manage` | Read signs in loaded chunks of railway worlds (repeat in other areas) |
| `/atcs import stations [page]` | `atcs.manage` | Show the stations drafted from scanned signs |
| `/atcs import services [min-trips]` | `atcs.manage` | Show lines and services suggested from observed trains |
| `/atcs import write [min-trips]` | `atcs.manage` | Write both proposals to import-proposal.yml for review |
| `/atcs import apply` | `atcs.manage` | Add the reviewed import-proposal.yml to the network |
| `/atcs import reset` | `atcs.manage` | Forget the scanned signs |

## /atcs fare

Fares between stations: explicit pairs, zones, and a formula over the route.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs fare check <from> <to>` | `atcs.use` | The fare between two stations and how it was worked out |
| `/atcs fare info` | `atcs.use` | Currency, formula, zones and explicit pairs |
| `/atcs fare generate` | `atcs.manage` | Write the fare of every pair of stations as a draft (fare-matrix.yml) to correct by hand |
| `/atcs fare apply [confirm]` | `atcs.manage` | Load the corrected draft into fares.yml; your changes are kept from then on |
| `/atcs fare set <from> <to> <fare\|auto>` | `atcs.manage` | Set the fare between two stations by hand, or let zones and formula decide again |
| `/atcs fare zone <station> <zone\|none>` | `atcs.manage` | Put a station in a zone |
| `/atcs fare zonefare <zone> <zone> <fare\|none>` | `atcs.manage` | The fare between two zones (a zone with itself too) |
| `/atcs fare formula <flat\|per-stop\|per-change\|round-to\|minimum> <value>` | `atcs.manage` | Set a part of the formula; distance bands are edited in fares.yml |
| `/atcs fare currency <symbol>` | `atcs.manage` | The symbol shown with fares, for example $ |

## /atcs timing

How good the arrival estimates are, measured against real arrivals.

| Command | Permission | |
|---|---|---|
| `/atcs timing report [line/service]` | `atcs.manage` | Mean and worst estimate errors per service, or per stop of one service |
| `/atcs timing reset` | `atcs.manage` | Forget the scored samples and start measuring afresh |
